title: ConvNeXt V2: Co-designing and Scaling ConvNets with Masked Autoencoders
layout_note: Two block diagrams side by side under large bold titles (V1 Block, V2 Block). Each is a top-to-bottom stack of three rounded boxes with a residual line running down the left side and rejoining at a circled plus at the bottom.
grouping: No containers; the two stacks are the same drawing repeated, aligned box for box, so only the inline annotations differ.
shapes_depth: Flat. White rounded rectangles with thin black outlines, each labelled with the layer and channel count (e.g. 'd7x7, 96', '1x1, 384'). Operations without weights (normalisation, activation) are not boxes but small text labels beside the connecting arrows. The input dimension sits as a small label at the top arrow. The residual skip is a thin black elbow line that leaves the top, runs down the left edge and enters a circled plus from the side.
proposed_highlight: The change between versions is written as signed coloured text placed on the arrow where it happens: a red bold '-LayerScale' at the removal point in the old block and a green bold '+GRN' at the insertion point in the new block; everything else is black.
lesson: Show a block modification as a before/after pair of identical stacks and mark the edit as signed, coloured inline text at the exact arrow it affects (red minus for removed, green plus for added).
notes: venue and year as recorded by Semantic Scholar. The paper's masked-autoencoder pre-training is drawn elsewhere (its Figure 2); this card is the block-detail figure. The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded it as one embedded image); kb measure reported photo_share null and measured all its pixels as drawing.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two identical vertical block diagrams side by side, ConvNeXt V1 Block and V2 Block, each a stack of three layer boxes (d7x7 96, 1x1 384, 1x1 96) with a residual skip down the left into a circled plus.
insights.data: Layers are white rounded rectangles labelled by kernel and width; normalization/activation (LN, GELU) are plain text on the arrows between boxes; the 96-d input dimension is noted on the top arrow.
insights.emphasis: The only differences are coloured text annotations on the arrows: red '-LayerScale' in V1 (removed) and green '+GRN' in V2 (added).
insights.flow: Top to bottom in each block; the residual runs down the left edge and joins at the bottom.

arrangement.units: two unframed side-by-side blocks with bold titles at top
arrangement.inputs_as: a bare arrow labelled with the channel width (96-d)
arrangement.shared: same skeleton redrawn; only the coloured diff annotations differ
